text.text: Cisco RF Gateway 10

graphic.text: Cisco RF Gateway 10

text.text: The Cisco RF Gateway 10 platform provides the scalability and high-availability features required to support escalating U-EQAM channel capacity needs. To meet the growing demand of advanced interactive and high definition video services, network operators needs to be able to meet new thresholds of performance, capacity, power consumption, ease of management, and scalability. The Cisco RF Gateway 10 builds on the RF Gateway 1 and provides the following benefits: Reduces operational cost of installing, configuring, and managing U-EQAM devices while offering the ability to increase chassis capacity with field-upgradable components for simplified network buildout and increased service velocity Supports multiple video encryption options including PowerKey, DVB/Simulcrypt and PME. Integrates with a wide variety of network architectures requiring advanced switching and routing features Reduces cost and complexity of WAN connections through 10Gigabit Ethernet interfaces Enables expansion in system capacity without RF network re-cabling Improves rack cabling efficiencies and access

graphic.text:
The Cisco RF Gateway 10 platform provides the scalability and high-availability features required to support escalating U-EQAM channel capacity needs. To meet the growing demand of advanced interactive and high definition video services, network operators needs to be able to meet new thresholds of performance, capacity, power consumption, ease of management, and scalability. The Cisco RF Gateway 10 builds on the RF Gateway 1 and provides the following benefits:
Reduces operational cost of installing, configuring, and managing U-EQAM devices while offering the ability to increase chassis capacity with field-upgradable components for simplified network buildout and increased service velocity
Supports multiple video encryption options including PowerKey, DVB/Simulcrypt and PME.
Integrates with a wide variety of network architectures requiring advanced switching and routing features
Reduces cost and complexity of WAN connections through 10Gigabit Ethernet interfaces
Enables expansion in system capacity without RF network re-cabling
Improves rack cabling efficiencies and access

text.text: DS384 Line Card

graphic.text: DS384 Line Card

text.text: The Cisco RFGW-DS384 line card is a 8-port, 384-channel universal edge quadrature amplitude modulation modulator (U-EQAM). The DS384 Line Card offers concurrent support for standard and high definition digital broadcast television, switched digital video (SDV), video-on-demand (VoD), and DOCSIS modular cable modem termination system (M-CMTS) services. Cable operators can choose to configure the RF Gateway Downstream 384 as a DOCSIS only, video only, or a DOCSIS and video shared universal edge QAM. Supports PowerKey, DVB/Simulcrypt and PME encryption.

graphic.text:
The Cisco RFGW-DS384 line card is a 8-port, 384-channel universal edge quadrature amplitude modulation modulator (U-EQAM).

The DS384 Line Card offers concurrent support for standard and high definition digital broadcast television, switched digital video (SDV), video-on-demand (VoD), and DOCSIS modular cable modem termination system (M-CMTS) services.

Cable operators can choose to configure the RF Gateway Downstream 384 as a DOCSIS only, video only, or a DOCSIS and video shared universal edge QAM.

Supports PowerKey, DVB/Simulcrypt and PME encryption.
